reviewed: Only exact blackhole/perf HTTPS hosts, sh.jd.com /j/<id> and mars.jd.com /log/sdk/v2 HTTPS requests are read
No network, process, dynamic code or logging API
Capture and manual status forward the original request unchanged
Credentials are stored only in dedicated local App storage
Cross-request pairing is explicitly unverified and limited to fifteen minutes; observed changes suspend pairing without deleting raw peer data
V2 isolates legacy writers; merged output and status are rechecked after writes with bounded reconciliation
Only explicit clear deletes raw records; malformed requests and expiry never delete a fresh peer capture
Only fixed status codes reach notifications
limits: Current JD App and Loon compatibility still require phone testing
Local storage is not claimed to be encrypted
Expired raw values remain until explicit clear; view expiry is checked on execution, not by BoxJs
No cross-execution transaction or chronological guarantee for simultaneous writes to the same field; sustained changes report busy
Pause App traffic before clear; an already-started raw write can finish late but its revoked generation cannot merge
Time proximity cannot prove that wskey and pin belong to the same account
No conversion, renewal or Qinglong acceptance is performed
